arithmetic: Canonical fractions p/q (or integers), with positive denominator; no floating point.
description: Exact rational nonnegative factors for the square of the fixed 11 by 11 MAT-C matrix.

indexing.C: Indices 0..3 are A; indices 4..10 are B.
indexing.Lean_Fin_3_times_Fin_6: Pair (k,a) maps to 6*k+a for 0 <= k < 3, 0 <= a < 6.
indexing.Lean_Option_Fin_6: some i maps to i for 0 <= i < 6; none maps to 6.
indexing.Lean_Option_perturbation_index: some (k,a) maps to 6*k+a in 0..17; none maps to the final simplex column/row 18.
indexing.cross_factor_order: Original terms 1,2,3 precede simplex terms 0..18, for 22 total terms.
indexing.tensor_square: Pair (i,j) has row or column index 11*i+j, with 0 <= i,j < 11.

limitation: Width 109 is an upper bound. This certificate contains no claim that a smaller factorization is impossible and no novelty claim.
matrix_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON of the matrix of canonical rational strings, separators=(',', ':').
